description: Minimum semantic payload required for a management quality answer to reach human review. Derived from M37.8 Sun Pharma baseline. M45.2 candidate failed this contract.

simple_answer.constraint: Must contain factual grounding: specific counts, named items, or evidence references — not only editorial synthesis
simple_answer.why: The delivery descriptor alone (FOLLOW_THROUGH_LARGELY_UNVERIFIED) is meaningless without the counts that ground it

key_points.constraint: At least 3 entries; at least one must contain factual specifics (counts, named items, lifecycle states)
key_points.why: M45.2 candidate's 4 generic dimension summaries provided no evidence an investor could act on

what_evidence_shows.constraint: Non-empty list; entries must reference observable events or metrics, not only conclusions
what_evidence_shows.why: Evidence density: investors need to see what actually happened, not only what it implies

what_is_not_yet_proven.constraint: Non-empty string or list; must name at least one material unresolved state
what_is_not_yet_proven.why: UNKNOWN preservation — M45.2 candidate omitted explicit uncertainty enumeration

deterministic_precision_facts.constraint: List with >= 3 entries; each entry must have metric, value, semantic_meaning; delivery follow-through entry required
deterministic_precision_facts.why: DPFs are the machine-verifiable evidence grounding; M45.2 candidate had zero DPFs — PACP cannot detect this absence

behavioral_descriptor.constraint: Must appear verbatim in simple_answer; must match canonical descriptor from management_progression
behavioral_descriptor.why: Descriptor anchors the synthesis to canonical evidence state

what_to_monitor.constraint: Non-empty list; at least one item referencing an unresolved management commitment or risk
what_to_monitor.why: Monitoring value — investors need actionable forward-looking items, not only backward assessment

what_may_mean_economically.constraint: If present: financial metrics may not independently establish management quality
what_may_mean_economically.note: Required when financial context is material to management assessment; absence acceptable if financial evidence is limited

what_management_says.constraint: If present: must quote/paraphrase actual disclosures, not synthesize management intent

management_consistency_map.note: Machine-readable supplement; not required for investor value

claims.note: Internal plan metadata; not investor-facing. Presence acceptable; not required. Must not contain prohibited language that is absent from investor-facing text (residual defect from M45.2 MQS-006).

deterministic_fact_pack_sources.dpfs: deterministically assembled from progression_counts + commitment_counts + financial_metrics

deterministic_assembler_provides: key_points factual count entries (injected if LLM omits)
llm_vs_deterministic_boundary.invariant: If LLM omits a deterministic factual value, the assembler still preserves it. LLM prose cannot overwrite deterministic counts or DPF values.

release_eligibility.pacp_role: Tests semantic safety (no rating leakage, descriptor present, evidence fidelity)
release_eligibility.eiv_role: Tests investor completeness (factual counts, DPFs, uncertainty coverage, monitoring value)
release_eligibility.note: PACP PASS alone is no longer sufficient. M45.2 demonstrated a PACP-passing answer can be WORSE than the certified baseline.
